title: Carry out due diligence before importing regulated timber products
what: A person importing a regulated timber product must comply with the due diligence requirements for importing it, and must not import a regulated timber product that is, is made from, or includes illegally logged timber.

sources.title: Illegal Logging Prohibition Act 2012
sources.quote: 9 Importing illegally logged timber in regulated timber products Fault-based offence (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person imports a thing; and (b) the thing is, is made from, or includes, illegally logged timber; and (c) the thing is a regulated timber product; and (d) the thing is not prescribed as exempt by the rules for the purposes of this paragraph.

sources.title: Illegal Logging Prohibition Act 2012
sources.quote: 12 Importing regulated timber products Fault-based offence (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person imports a thing; and (b) the thing is a regulated timber product; and (c) the person does not comply with one or more due diligence requirements for importing the regulated timber product;
